label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.10 a.4…: Even on the hypothesis of beginningless and endless…
locator: I q.10 a.4 co.: dato quod tempus semper fuerit et semper futurum sit
interpretation: The conditional grants endless time for the comparison; it does not endorse an eternal world. Absence of beginning and end alone is not the primary discriminator, and eternity is not identified with a distinguished temporal now.
